run_download_tests: run the DownloadTests suite to verify pipeline downloading from HuggingFace Hub with safetensors and variant support
run_custom_pipeline_tests: run the CustomPipelineTests suite to test loading custom pipelines from remote repos and local directories
run_pipeline_fast_tests: run the PipelineFastTests suite to test pipeline components, scheduler swapping, and save/load roundtrips
run_pipeline_slow_tests: run the PipelineSlowTests suite to test full pipeline inference and Flax/PyTorch conversion workflows
run_lora_hotswap_tests: run the TestLoraHotSwappingForPipeline suite to test LoRA adapter hotswapping with torch.compile without recompilation
